name: singlet_enrichment_pseudobulk_pathway_scoring
title: Sample-level pathway activity scoring
description: Scores each sample or pseudobulk group for each gene set from a normalized sample-by-gene layer and writes a sample-by-set matrix with per-set member coverage. The default ulm method scores each sample without reference to the cohort; gsva is cohort-relative and must be compared only within one input. Do not use on raw counts or single cells; use enrichment.per_cell_gene_set_scoring for cell-level activity.

dataset.description: Dataset handle (.singlet path, URI or workspace handle) holding the normalized sample-by-gene layer.

method.description: Scoring method. ulm is the default and is cohort-independent; gsva is cohort-relative.

gene_set_key.description: Name of the gene-set collection under uns; members may carry signs or weights.

layer.description: Normalized layer to score. Layers whose values are all non-negative integers are refused.

sample_key.description: obs column that identifies each sample or pseudobulk group.

min_set_size.description: Smallest number of set members present in the layer; smaller sets are dropped and listed in metadata.

max_set_size.description: Largest number of set members present in the layer; larger sets are dropped and listed in metadata.

gsva.description: GSVA options, used only when method is gsva.

kcdf.description: Density transform: gaussian kernel across samples, or none for the empirical CDF.

tau.description: Exponent on the rank statistic in the random walk.

maxdiff.description: Use the sum of the largest positive and negative deviations.

singscore.description: singscore options, used only when method is singscore.

stable_reference.description: Stable reference genes for the normalisation-robust variant; null uses global ranks.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obsm/pathway_score_ulm. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: n_samples, n_sets_scored, n_sets_dropped, set_coverage_median, cohort_relative, method. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
